title: &aThe Wide World
subtitle: Maps, waystones, villages, dungeons and castles in the sky.

quests.title: A World Worth Mapping
quests.subtitle: Xaero's Minimap and World Map
desc: The minimap sits in the corner of your screen. Press &eM&r for the full &eWorld Map&r and &eB&r to drop a waypoint where you stand.
Your deaths are marked automatically, and OPAC party members can show up on the map. The land is &eTerralith&r: about a hundred biomes, and a title appears each time you enter a new one.

quests.title: A Waystone for Home
desc: Waystones stand in villages and in the wild (about one every 25 chunks). Craft one for your base (see JEI) so you can always get home.
Teleporting costs XP: about one level per 100 blocks (27 at most), and 27 levels to change dimension. Warping to a global waystone is free. Each player activates a waystone for themselves.

quests.title: The Party Network
desc: A &eSharestone&r is a waystone that links to every other sharestone of the same colour. Everyone can use it, so it's the easiest network for a party.
Pick a colour for your group (green suits the Corps) and put one at each base, farm and dungeon you use. Warp Plates and scrolls also travel for free.

quests.title: Villages of a Hundred Styles
desc: Vanilla villages are gone. &eCTOV&r and &eTowns and Towers&r build villages that match their biome: desert oases, alpine towns, jungle treehouses, swamp stilts, fortified walls.
Visit one. Guards defend it, traders deal there, and many keep a waystone near the centre.

quests.title: The Illager Manor
quests.subtitle: Dungeons and Taverns
desc: &eDungeons and Taverns&r scatters dangerous houses across the land: illager manors and hideouts, witch villas, toxic lairs and crypts. Wandering traders even sell maps to them.
An &eIllager Manor&r is a full mansion of evokers and vindicators. Go with friends.

quests.title: The Third Trial
desc: Shrine Towers hold combat trials in five tiers, and each tier is harder than the last. The loot grows with the danger.
Find a &eTier 3&r shrine and clear it. Bring the party and plenty of food.

quests.title: Pirates on the Horizon
desc: &eWDA: Seven Seas&r launches warships onto the oceans: the Victory Frigate, Unicorn Galleon, Corsair Corvette and Pirate Junk.
Board a Victory Frigate. Watch for cannons, and bring a boat in case you have to leave in a hurry.

quests.title: Puzzles in the Sand
quests.subtitle: YUNG's Better Desert Temples
desc: &eYUNG's&r rebuilt the classic structures: temples, witch huts, ocean monuments, fortresses, mineshafts and the stronghold.
The new desert temples hide puzzles and traps, and the treasure room only opens when you solve them. Look around before you pull any lever.

quests.title: When Dungeons Arise
desc: &eWhen Dungeons Arise&r builds huge dungeons: the Foundry, Mechanical Nest, Plague Asylum, Coliseum, Shiraz Palace, Thornborn Towers and more.
Start small: an &eIllager Campsite&r. The big ones take a full party and a full evening.

quests.title: The Burning Keep
desc: &eYUNG's Better Nether Fortresses&r turns the fortress into a real castle, with a keep, lava halls and blaze-filled towers.
Blazes drop the rods you need for Create's Blaze Burner and the Eye of Ender.

quests.title: The Great Stronghold
desc: &eYUNG's Better Strongholds&r are vast: libraries, prisons, crypts and the End portal room deep inside. The nearest one is about 2,000 blocks from spawn.
Follow an Eye of Ender. Mark the portal room with a waystone: you'll be back.

quests.title: Fortress in the Clouds
desc: High above the land, WDA's &eHeavenly&r sky fortresses (Rider, Challenger, Conqueror) float at cloud height.
You'll need a way up: a balloon (Create Aeronautics), an elytra, or a very tall tower. Don't fall off.

quests.title: The Lost Castle
desc: Somewhere far out (about 9,500 blocks from spawn) stands &eThe Lost Castle&r, one huge, rare castle dungeon.
A long trip and a long fight. Optional, for the brave.

quests.title: Villages Above the Clouds
desc: &eSky Villages&r float high above the ground, on islands of their own.
Get up there with a balloon, an elytra or a long staircase, and visit one. A waystone up there saves the climb next time.

quests.title: Islands in the Sky
desc: &eEmber's Floating Islands&r adds seventeen sky islands: amethyst rocks, a cherry shrine, a cemetery, camps, a steampunk island and a hut with its own waystone.
Find the &eHut with a Waystone&r and activate it: a free landing spot in the sky.

quests.title: The Sky Whale
desc: Giant whales drift through the sky carrying ships on their backs, and one carries an arena.
Land on a &eSky Whale Ship&r. Whatever lives up there won't be glad to see you.

quests.title: The Levitation Stone
quests.subtitle: Castle in the Sky
desc: One floating castle hides more than 10,000 blocks from spawn. The &eLevitation Stone&r leads you to it.
Craft it (an elytra ringed by netherite ingots and phantom membranes) or buy one from a master Cartographer. It needs the End and the Nether first, so it's a late trip.

quests.title: Castle in the Sky
desc: Inside the castle, &cred&r, &eyellow&r and &9blue&r keys open the doors of the same colour. Find each key before you try its door.
The Levitation Crystal waits at the castle's heart, and so do its guardians. Fly or float there with your party.

quests.title: Laputa's Heart
desc: Conquer the Castle in the Sky. Few find it, and fewer leave with its crystal.
The Lantern Corps took note.
